summary: Advanced remains plausible as a design label after the organic-starter rewrite. The solver must distinguish apparently reasonable but incomplete legacy controls from the actual restart/reconciliation invariants across more than 3,000 substantive LOC, eleven COBOL decision interfaces, shell orchestration and SQL durability. The rewrite removes clerical no-op discovery shortcuts while retaining the same 29 coupled manifestations and 30 fail-to-pass behavioral requirements. Final empirical difficulty remains intentionally unmeasured until the authorized official model trials.

evidence.observation: Current merge ref reports 3080 substantive solver-visible LOC, 29 manifestations, six roots, 29 interrelated manifestations, 27 causal edges and 37 tests with 30 F2P.
Several reconciliation metrics look credible yet encode wrong scope or incomplete invariants, increasing diagnosis/reasoning load without adding arbitrary requirements.
Control flow contains partial integrity/reconciliation checks, so the solver cannot simply search for explicit forced failures/no-op functions.
Untouched organic starter fails all 30 F2P cases while preserving seven P2P cases; current reference solution passes all 37.
